results.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
results.notes:
BlackRose is ScaredofAniplex+Modified NF with modified Unfucked (TS adapted from German CR) TS
ScaredofAniplex is CR Majin WEBRip with the JPN BD spliced in for some scenes
The JPN BD has terrible sharpening (possibly sourced from a 4K upscale?). Compression is better than CR but it doesn't really matter when the lineart is destroyed
The Majin stream is a new test encode on CR, it has much higher bitrate peaks and offers significantly better compression in busy scenes, as well as less banding in general
